name: vlm_sam_test_20260922_sub6_step30
privacy_check: 'worker' class: 0 instances; 22 captions mention people. Spot review of 36 candidate frames found no identifiable people.

pipeline.captioner: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, NF4 4-bit, greedy decoding, max_new_tokens 320, max_pixels 1280*28*28

split_policy: no split: all images are test-only (sampled evaluation set)
caveats: Masks and captions are generated by models; no human verification or quantitative accuracy has been done. Expect false positives at low confidence (see 'score' in annotations) and occasional wrong class names.
Captions are generated independently of the masks and may mention objects that were not detected, or miss detected ones.
Chinese text in images (banners/signs) is often OCR'd incorrectly by the caption model; do not trust captions as OCR ground truth.

Sampled evaluation set: every 30th frame of a ~9.5 min continuous capture session (~6 s apart). Images are related views of one site, not independent scenes; scores on this set are not a generalization benchmark.
COCO polygons fill holes: stuff-class masks such as 'wall' may include window openings. Use annotations/semantic/*.png for pixel-exact labels.
